label: A reporting verb (says, said, asked, replied, wrote, warns, admits; declara, erklärte, explique, يقول) placed after the quote or reported statement and before its speaker ('The road is closed, confirms the sheriff'; '"Too late," sighed the porter'); fires on the verb. Quiet for the same verbs in normal speaker-first order ('The sheriff confirms…', '"…," the porter sighed') and for 'according to'. Also fires, more weakly, on a motion verb placed after a fronted place phrase and before its subject ('Through the gate trotted a pony'), so that is not a near miss.
